name: source-to-syllabus
description: Turn any codebase into a beautiful, multi-page interactive HTML course that takes a reader from 'I have no idea what's going on' to 'I understand this and can explain it.' Deep codebase analysis, Overview + Deep Dive pages per module, adjustable annotation depth up to line-by-line annotated source walkthroughs, comprehension checkpoints (explain-back, predict-before-reveal, retrieval practice, execution tracer), runnable exercises, verified code provenance, course search, and a capstone.
